late.title: Late check-out fee
late.enable: Charge a fee when guests check out after {time} on their booked check-out day
late.intro: Surcharge as a % of the booking’s nightly rate:
late.hint: Default, as is customary: 30% before 15:00, 50% before 18:00, a full night after that. Staying into the next day counts one night per 24 hours (better to extend the stay). At check-out the app suggests the amount; the front desk applies, changes or waives it (changing or waiving needs a reason and is logged).

cancellation.title: Cancellation policy
cancellation.freeHoursHint: Leave empty if there is no free cancellation
cancellation.detailsPlaceholder: Describe the cancellation policy, fees, refunds...
cancellation.detailsHint: Guests see this policy before booking on the website.

deposit.label: Deposit for website bookings (%)
deposit.hint: 0 = no deposit, guests pay at the front desk. With a deposit, guests pay by bank transfer through PayOS as they book, the money goes straight to the hotel’s account, and the booking is confirmed automatically once it arrives.
deposit.deadline: Cancel the booking automatically if no deposit is paid within
deposit.deadlineHint: If the money has not arrived in time, the booking is cancelled, the room is released and the guest gets an email. The app checks with PayOS first: if the guest has paid, the booking is confirmed. Without auto-cancel, the booking waits for the hotel to handle it.
deposit.payosMissing: PayOS is not connected (Bank accounts → Online payments): guests do not pay a deposit until it is.
